rules: Every tool must declare accepted inputs and produced outputs.
Outputs should be reusable as inputs by downstream tools without forced re-upload where technically possible.
Paid export quantity must derive from the same execution plan used for final output.
UI copy describes user outcome; internal capability IDs never appear in normal UI.
Local-first capabilities must not upload file bytes unless the user enters a declared online step.
Every public tool must have desktop/mobile route coverage and at least one real fixture.
